props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initially selected value (uncontrolled). When omitted, no item is selected and the form
submits nothing for the group.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether the control is disabled: it cannot be interacted with and sets `aria-disabled`.
When omitted, the control inherits `disabled` from the surrounding `Field`; an explicit
`false` overrides the `Field`.

props.name: form
props.description:
The id of a `<form>` the hidden inputs belong to, instead of the closest
ancestor form.

props.name: id
props.description:
The ID of the control's main focusable element, which a surrounding `Field` label points to
with `for`. A unique ID is generated when omitted. The control's related parts (hidden
input, label, description) derive their IDs from it, so keep it unique on the page.

props.name: indicatorPosition
props.description: Placement of the selection indicator relative to the label.

props.name: items
props.description: Items to render, either plain strings (used as both `value` and `label`) or `Item` objects.
examples:
import { RadioGroup } from 'moraine'

<RadioGroup
  items={[
    'Free',
    { value: 'pro', label: 'Pro', description: 'Billed monthly' },
    { value: 'team', label: 'Team', disabled: true },
  ]}
/>

props.name: legend
props.description:
Legend that labels the group (rendered as a `<legend>` inside the `<fieldset>`). A `Field`
label takes precedence for `aria-labelledby`.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow-key navigation wraps from the last item to the first and back. Disabled items are skipped.

props.name: name
props.description:
The name of the control, used for native form submission. When omitted, the control uses
the name of its form binding or a string `name` set on the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: onBlur
props.description:
Focus event when focus leaves the radio group entirely, called before the `Field` blur
notification. Moving focus between items does not fire it.

props.name: onFocus
props.description:
Focus event when focus enters the radio group from outside, called before the `Field`
focus notification. Moving focus between items does not fire it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description:
Called when the user selects a different item, with that item's `value`. It does not fire for
programmatic changes to `value`, for re-selecting the current item, or while the group is
`disabled` or `readOnly`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Direction items are laid out in.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Whether the control is read-only: the value is visible and focusable but cannot be changed,
and `aria-readonly` is set. When omitted, the control inherits `readOnly` from the
surrounding `Field`.

props.name: required
props.description:
Whether the control is required, which sets `aria-required` (and the native `required`
attribute where the control renders a native input). When omitted, the control inherits
`required` from the surrounding `Field`.

props.name: size
props.description: Visual size of the component.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: value
props.description:
The value of the selected item (controlled). Leave it `undefined` for uncontrolled usage; an
empty string or a value matching no item leaves every item unselected.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Layout of the options. `list` stacks plain radio rows with a gap, where only the control and
label select. `card` renders each option as a separate bordered, padded card that selects
when clicked anywhere and gets a primary border when checked. `table` joins the options into
one bordered block with shared edges; the checked row gets a primary border and a tinted
background.

props.name: description
props.description: Description for the radio item.

props.name: disabled
props.description:
Whether this item is disabled. It cannot be selected or focused with the keyboard, and the
other items stay interactive.

props.name: label
props.description: Label for the radio item. It names the radio input for assistive technology.

props.name: value
props.description:
Value of the radio item, submitted with the form and passed to `onValueChange`. Must be
unique within the group.
